text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I have a track<n>reserved for
afternoon practice, but<n>there's suddenly an
unforeseen<n>downpour.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look, Big Brother! It's raining cats<n>and dogs!
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look, Big Sister! It's raining cats and<n>dogs!
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted me to train on a<n>soft track,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted me to train on a<n>soft track,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I thought if I wished for sunny<n>weather... it would
probably rain<n>instead!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I hung up tons of sunshine dolls in my<n>room and
wished for it to be sunny<n>every day!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And now, look at the weather! At this<n>rate, the track
will be soft by the<n>afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While it's hard to say if this is really<n>something to
celebrate, Rice's<n>happiness makes it easy to
overlook.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: In the afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no way...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All the rain from this morning has<n>dried up! The
track is firm again!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I guess I should have known better<n>than to expect
things to work out my<n>way...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is plummeting like a<n>rock! At this
rate...
choice_data_list: Let's take advantage of the sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is plummeting like a<n>rock! At this
rate...
choice_data_list: Let's take advantage of the sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Now?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What a big voice you have, Big<n>Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What a big voice you have, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... R-raaain! FAAALL!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Really? I-I never shout like this. It's<n>honestly a little
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but it's kinda fun too...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We continue to do voice training on<n>the empty track
by screaming at the<n>sky.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's exhausting, but at least it keeps<n>Rice Shower's
spirits high.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Take advantage of the sunshine?<n>What do you
mean?
choice_data_list: Let's practice on the track while it's firm!
Let's practice on the track while it's firm!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-is it really okay to change our plans?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're right, though... The track doeslook perfect.
choice_data_list: That's it! Let's look on the bright side.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look on... the bright side...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. The sunshine<n>feels so good!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to start training right now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to start training right now!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's motivation rises once<n>more!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She makes good use of the firm track<n>for the rest of
the day's training.
